name: camayoc_gp_unverified_stretch
description: golden-paths Q4: for one trajectory, which steps produced a Verification and which produced none. The unverified stretch of a successful trajectory is where blessing must lean on human judgment.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?step ?order ?label ?verification WHERE { ?step a aegis:Step ; aegis:stepOf <{trajectory}> ; aegis:stepOrder ?order ; rdfs:label ?label . OPTIONAL { ?step aegis:verifiedBy ?verification } } ORDER BY ?order

params.name: trajectory
params.description: trajectory parameter for this stored query.
